noneBody: The post will be applied without a feature image. Pick one below if you change your mind.
notChosenTitle: You haven't chosen an image yet.
notChosenBody: If you apply without choosing, the post has no feature image: the connector no longer adds one on its own.
downloaded: Downloaded locally (not in Ghost). It's uploaded when you apply.
altHint: Describe what's shown, for screen readers and SEO.
caption: Caption
captionHint: The source attribution is always added after it.
cancelReplace: Cancel and keep the current one
clickHint: Click one to choose it: it's downloaded to your machine so you can view it and edit its text. Nothing reaches Ghost until you apply.

errors.notPlanned: An image can only be chosen on a current plan ("planned").
errors.outsideData: Image path outside the data folder
errors.gone: That image is no longer in the list. Search again.

current.caption: Current featured image in Ghost.
current.kept: It stays as it is unless you choose another one below or remove it.
current.willRemove: It will be removed when you apply.
current.willReplace: It will be replaced by the one you chose below when you apply.
current.storageNote: Nothing changes in Ghost until you apply. Ghost's API can't delete uploaded files: if you replace or remove this image, the old file stays in your site's media library. Only the image you choose is uploaded, once, on apply.

only.intro: No pending plan: you can change just the featured image. The text is not touched and no AI is used.
only.note: Only the featured image, its alt text and caption are written.

notes.noSources: No image source is configured. Add a key in Settings or enable Openverse.

emptyTitle: Not a trace of photos for “{query}”
emptyBody: Try other words or another source. English searches usually find more.
